items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Paul Cohen and I was in the trumpet section...

ctx.x: No, he didn't have no contract, and I knew it. But I just wanted... I was tired of playing them Southern beats anyway. So I quit Andy to go back with Barnet.
And then I wanted... Oh yeah, that's right. Paul Cohen and I was in the trumpet section...
